name: tradingview-stock-screener-scraper
description: Screen stocks, crypto, and forex from TradingView's keyless scanner API. Filter by market cap, price, volume, sector, P/E, dividend yield, RSI, and daily change, then get one row per matching symbol with live price, percent change, volume, market cap, P/E, dividend yield, RSI, sector, industry, exchange, country, and YTD performance. No login. Pay per row.
